jobs_results.description:
QUALITY ASSURANCE – TESTER (REMOTE / HYBRID MADRID)

Portuguese company hires for remote/hybrid work

FLUENT ENGLISH AND SPANISH (C1/C2)

Description

Description: As a TV Software Quality Assurance (QA) Tester, your main responsibility will be to ensure the quality and functionality of our TV software products. This will primarily involve conducting manual functional testing on TV software, including set-top boxes (STB), smart TVs, mobile platforms, web applications, and other TV-related technologies. You will be responsible for tasks such as bug reporting, trace analysis, and exploratory testing, in order to identify and document any issues or improvements needed for the software.

Must Have:

English Speaker

Spanish Speaker

Able to test locally in Madrid

Strong experience in QA testing for TV software or related field

Solid understanding of software testing methodologies and processes

Familiarity with bug tracking and test management tools

Excellent problem-solving skills and... attention to detail

Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

Nice to Have:

Experience with smart TVs, streaming devices, and other TV-related technologies

Knowledge of video codecs, streaming protocols, and DRM

Familiarity with automation testing tools and frameworks

Understanding of agile development methodologies

Ability to analyze and interpret technical specifications

Top 5 Skills:

QA testing for TV software or related field

Understanding of software testing methodologies and processes

Bug tracking and test management tools

Problem-solving skills and attention to detail

Communication skills (written and verbal)

Junior/Mid Senior

jobs_results.description:
Who we are

Allot is an industry leader in network security and visibility. A global growing company in cyber-security with a strong Tier1 customer base. We embrace an Agile way of working, priding ourselves on being fast, diverse and dynamic. We are real team players who are ready to go the extra mile to succeed. We believe that anyone can make an impact and together our team spirit makes all the difference. This is your opportunity to develop, professionally and personally

What we’re looking for

Talented QA Engineer to join our Cyber Security R&D group.

What you’ll do
• Quality of innovative security solution in a widely deployed Product
• The exigence of robustness, efficiency, and performance
• Use the state-of-the-art technology for testing with CI/CD and automated tests

Requirements:

What you should have
• 2 to 5 years of Software Testing experience.
• Bachelor's degree in computer science computer engineering or a related field
• Design and execute test plans for feature... requirements
• Understanding of relational databases (SQL)
• Practical experience in Unix/Linux environments
• IP Networking knowledge, Industry certifications will be an advantage, such as CCNA/CCNP
• Working experience with traffic generators tools
• Advanced English level
• Strong communication skills with a willingness to convey ideas and the ability to work in a collaborative environment

Advantage:
• Cyber Security professional background experience
• Experience with Kubernetes especially with on premise installation
• Monitoring and logging stacks (such as: Elasticsearch ,Fluoend\Filebeat , Prometheus, Kibana , Grafana)
• Working experience with MongoDb, PostgreSQL
• Python developing knowledge
• ISTQB certifications
• Experience working in an Agile environment

Only English CV will be considered

Region (Website):

Europe, Middle East & Africa

jobs_results.title: QA Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Job Description:

DXC Technology is a leading independent provider of IT services worldwide, helping its customers harness the power of innovation as a catalyst for success. We have nearly 6,000 customers in both the private and public sectors in 70 countries. Our technological independence, global expertise and extensive partner network combine to deliver next-generation IT services and solutions. DXC Spain is increasingly becoming the trusted IT provider for the most important companies throughout the country.

In DXC Spain we are looking for a QA Analyst to join and lead one of our teams. This is a new global testing service for a major client in the financial sector that provides DXC as a sole partner.

What are we looking for?
• People eager to participate in a functional testing team of customer applications.
• Knowledge and experience in the banking sector, in the Transactional Banking, Corporate Banking, Risk, Digital, etc. business areas.
• Experience in functional testing of... applications supported by different technologies: mainframe, middleware and/or web or digital environments.
• Experience in analyzing and interpreting project requirements from functional analysis or user story.
• Experience in the design of test scenarios and test cases according to the defined requirements. Knowledge and experience in some of the testing tools and frameworks, such as; HPQC, ALM or similar.
• Experience in identifying issues, reporting and following up with development teams. Knowledge in cross-functional management tools such as Jira,
• Experience in reporting results and participating in follow-ups and committees. Good communication with the client
• Good oral and written communication skills
• Some certification in the area of testing such as ISTQB will be an asset
• Language: English medium-high level (minimum B2)

What will your day-to-day work be like?
• You will work in a multidisciplinary team integrated in an international and multicultural environment.
• You will participate in the presentation of development projects (Project Kickoff).
• You will analyze project requirements
• You will define the testing strategy and processes
• Create the test plan and implement it in tools
• Validate both test preparation and test results, applying the input and output criteria for each test phase and preparing the project closeout report
• Identify and document defects and issues
• Ensure process compliance, identifying gaps and opportunities for process improvement
• Participate in meetings with the development teams

What will you find at DXC?
• An attractive salary depending on the experience provided.
• Ongoing training by the company in multiple technologies, especially cloud!
• Flexibility and work-life balance. Smart work if needed.
• The best work environment , not said by us but our employees on our satisfaction surveys.
• Visibility: we will encourage the attendance and organization of events, meetups and seminars.
• Flexible Payment Plan: restaurant ticket, kindergarten ticket, transportation ticket… Choose the one(s) that suit you most

jobs_results.title: QA Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a QA Engineer (flexible working time and partial remote work possible) to join our growing team in Madrid, Spain.

Join our team to work on our cloud photogrammetry software suite. Angular, Openlayers, ThreeJS, Python, AWS, and various libraries constitute the technical stack we use to turn images into geolocalized 2D and 3D scenes using our processing engine. Our applications help our customers to create digital twins of their surrounding environment to analyze it. We are an agile team where code reviews, pair programming, and continuous deployment to production are part of the culture.

You will play a central role in the quality management, delivery, and scaling of our applications. From the initial definition to acceptance, release, deployment, and support, your key contribution will help the team push the web limit.

If you are passionate about maps, 3D, and managing quality; enjoy learning and sharing good practices; are at ease working autonomously; and... communicate good vibes alongside bug reports, we need to talk.

Responsibilities
• Develop manual or automated test plans meeting product requirements;
• Estimate, prioritize, plan, and coordinate your QA activities;
• Run both manual and automated tests;
• Report the quality of the product systems qualitatively and quantitatively via discovered bugs and test results;
• Maintain existing automated tests with team colleagues;
• Manage Test Data;
• Work with the other members of the cross-functional team;
• Answer internal queries about the Cloud capabilities, limitations, interfaces, general knowledge, etc;
• Stay up-to-date with the best test tools and methodologies.
• Essential:
• 2+ years of programming/scripting experience in Python, Javascript, or similar;
• 2+ years of web or mobile software testing work experience or similar roles;
• Experience in testing cloud or mobile software;
• Strong organizational skills to work autonomously;
• Excellent English communication skills (written, spoken, reading & listening);
• Desirable:
• Building Infrastructure Modeling (BIM) industry knowledge/experience
• GIS and/or Photogrammetry knowledge/experience
• Software engineering experience
• Flexible working hours
• Remote and office work in an international environment
• Private Health insurance with Mapfre
• Access to Gympass
• Mental, Legal and Financial assistance program
• Flexible benefits with Sodexo (childcare, transportation, restaurants)
• 25 days of paid vacation
• Budget for personal development and training
• Company Social Events like our yearly fondue in Switzerland
• Discounts for different activities and services with WeWork membership.

Working environment

Pix4D is a unique, fun, and intellectually stimulating company where you can grow and excel in your field. Our environment is authentic and multicultural, a place where we respect and learn from each other in the pursuit of being the best at what we do. Get more information here.

Recruitment

Pix4D promotes diversity and offers opportunities across all levels and career paths in all of its offices regardless of gender, race, or religion. We use standardized and structured interviews to ensure all candidates are treated equally and avoid any discrimination.

Company
When you work at Pix4D, you empower professionals worldwide to digitize reality through survey-grade georeferenced 2D maps and 3D models. These outputs can be measured, analyzed, and shared, all based on data from images taken by plane, drone, or mobile phone.

We build solutions that take advantage of technology including reality capture, computer vision, digital twins, and machine learning to help solve our customers' most complex challenges.

Founded in 2011, Pix4D has its headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland and commercial and R&D offices in Denver, Berlin, Bucharest, Tokyo and Madrid.
• #LI-VC1
• #LI-Hybrid

• Report bugs and errors to development teams and help troubleshoot issues
• Proficient in using test management tools like Quality Center, Jira, TFS, Azure DevOps.
• Able to understand backend processes
• Work with cross-functional teams to ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle
• Good team player and helps other QA Analysts in keeping critical deadlines.
• Works with geographically distributed teams to perform daily duties.
• Helps in Investigating and troubleshooting production issues... with the support teams and in resolving the issues on time.
• Able to multitask and handle conflicting priorities effectively.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
